notes: Dominant LUHK land-use assigned by majority overlap between the pilot 10m grid cell and the LUHK 2024 10m raster. This step does not extract thermal temperatures, calculate delta-T, or run prediction. The current pilot stage is thermal-first: outputs are plotted on `_T.JPG` using thermal image geometry and `thermal_profile` assumptions when metadata does not provide FOV or sensor size. Visible `_V.JPG` overlays are deferred. The overlay remains an approximate first-pass visualization using the north-up rectangular footprint assumption.
